Lily asked her mom, "Can I touch the sunflower?" Her mom replied, "No, Lily. The sunflower is not for touching. It's for looking at." 
Lily was sad, but she understood. The next day, Lily rode her bike past the sunflower again. But this time, she saw a butterfly on the sunflower. The butterfly was so attractive that Lily wanted to touch it. 
She asked her mom, "Can I touch the butterfly?" Her mom replied, "No, Lily. The butterfly is not for touching. It's for flying." 
Lily learned that some things are meant for looking and some things are meant for riding and flying. She was happy to see the sunflower and the butterfly every day on her bike rides.

Once upon a time, there was a little beetle. He was very small and had a hard shell that protected him from danger. One day, he saw a piece of candy on the ground and wanted to eat it. But the candy was too heavy for him to lift.
He tried and tried, but he couldn't lift it. Then, a big beetle came along and saw the little beetle struggling. The big beetle offered to help and lifted the candy for him. The little beetle was very grateful and thanked the big beetle.
The moral of the story is that sometimes we need help from others, and it's okay to ask for it. We should also be willing to help others when they need it.

Once upon a time, there was a poor neighbor who had a big cat. The cat was very fat and heavy, so the neighbor wanted to weigh it. She took the cat to the store where they had a big scale. She put the cat on the scale and saw that it weighed 20 pounds! 
The neighbor was very surprised because the cat was so heavy. She decided to put the cat on a diet so it could lose weight. She gave the cat less food and more exercise, like playing with toys. 
After a few weeks, the cat lost some weight and the neighbor was very happy. She weighed the cat again and saw that it now weighed 15 pounds. The cat was much healthier and happier, and the neighbor was proud of herself for helping her furry friend.

Once upon a time, there was a big house with a lot of rooms. The house was very tall and had a strong structure. One day, a clumsy mouse got inside the house and started running around. The people in the house saw the mouse and tried to catch it, but it was too fast. 
Then, a little girl came and said she could show them how to catch the mouse. She took a piece of cheese and put it in a trap. The mouse smelled the cheese and went inside the trap. The little girl was very happy to have caught the mouse and showed it to everyone. 
From that day on, the people in the house made sure to keep the doors closed so no more clumsy mice could get inside. And the little girl was very proud of herself for showing everyone how to catch the mouse.

Once upon a time, there was a little gray mouse named Timmy. He lived in a cozy hole in the wall of a big house. Timmy loved to play games with his friends, but he wasn't very good at them. He always lost and felt sad.
One day, Timmy's friend, a wise old owl, told him a story. The story was about a tortoise who won a race against a hare. The tortoise won because he didn't give up and kept going until the end.
Timmy thought about the story and decided to try again. He practiced every day and soon he became better at the games. One day, he finally won a game and felt so happy! Timmy learned that even if he didn't win every time, he should never give up and keep trying his best.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Benny. Benny loved to hop and play all day long. One day, Benny saw a shiny piece of jewelry on the ground. He picked it up and put it on his neck. He felt so happy and proud of himself. 
But then, he saw his friends, the squirrels, looking weak and sad. Benny realized that he had been selfish and didn't share his jewelry with his friends. So, he decided to bow his head and apologize to his friends. 
From that day on, Benny learned that sharing is important and it's not nice to make others feel weak or left out. He made sure to always share his toys and treats with his friends, and they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy cars and trucks. One day, Timmy's dad took him to the park to ride his bike. Timmy's bike had gears that made it go faster.
Timmy's dad asked him if he wanted to ride on the bike path. Timmy said yes and they rode on the clear path. Timmy loved the feeling of the wind in his hair as they rode faster and faster. 
After a while, Timmy's legs got tired and they stopped to take a break. Timmy's dad asked him if he wanted a snack and Timmy said yes. They sat on a bench and ate some crackers together. Timmy was happy to spend time with his dad and ride his bike with gears on the clear path.

Once upon a time, there was a deer named Bambi. Bambi wanted to play with his friends in the forest, but he couldn't find any comfortable clothes to wear. He tried on many clothes, but none of them fit him well. 
Bambi felt sad and worried that he wouldn't be able to play with his friends. Suddenly, he saw a rabbit hopping towards him. The rabbit asked Bambi what was wrong, and Bambi told him about his problem. 
The rabbit had an idea and took Bambi to a nearby store. There, they found a perfect outfit for Bambi that fit him just right. Bambi was so happy and grateful to the rabbit. He put on his new clothes and ran to play with his friends. 
From that day on, Bambi learned that it's important to ask for help when you have a problem and that there's always a solution to every problem.

Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy rabbit named Bongo. Bongo loved to eat radishes from the garden. One day, Bongo saw a little bird sitting on a branch. Bongo wanted to play with the bird, but he accidentally slapped the bird with his big, hairy paw. 
The little bird was very sad and flew away. Bongo felt bad and wanted to say sorry, but the bird was already gone. Bongo went back to eating his radishes, but he didn't feel happy anymore. 
Later that day, a big, scary fox came into the garden. Bongo tried to run away, but the fox caught him and ate him for dinner. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, they found a big green structure to climb on. 
Lily's friend, Timmy, said "Be careful, the edges are sharp!" 
Lily replied, "Don't worry, I'll be careful." She climbed up the structure and looked down at Timmy. "I can see everything from up here!" 
Timmy smiled and said, "Wow, you're so brave!" 
Lily felt proud of herself and they continued to play on the green structure for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys all day long. One day, while playing with his favorite toy car, it suddenly vanished! Timmy looked all around his room but couldn't find it anywhere. He felt sad and confused.
Just then, his mom came in and asked what was wrong. Timmy told her about his missing toy car. His mom looked around and found it under the bed. Timmy was so happy that his toy car wasn't gone forever!
Timmy's mom noticed that he was holding his arm and asked if it hurt. Timmy nodded and said it felt sore. His mom gave him a hug and a kiss and said she would make it feel better.
Timmy's dad came home from work and they all sat down for dinner. Timmy's grandpa joined them too. Timmy's grandpa was deaf, which meant he couldn't hear very well. They all had a great time together and Timmy forgot all about his missing toy car and sore arm.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, they decided to play a game of tag. Timmy was so excited to play that he rushed to the park.
When he got to the park, he saw a big barrel. It was so big that he could climb inside of it. The barrel was smooth and shiny. Timmy thought it was so cool.
As he was playing tag with his friends, he accidentally bumped into the barrel and it started rolling. Timmy tried to stop it, but it was too heavy. The barrel rolled all the way down the hill and into the pond. Timmy and his friends laughed and had so much fun watching the barrel float in the water.

Once upon a time, there was a big garage. It was where Daddy parked his car. One day, Mommy told Daddy that they needed more space in the garage. Daddy said he would increase the size of the garage. 
The next day, Daddy got to work. He used his tools to make the garage bigger. He worked very hard all day. When he was done, Mommy was very happy. She said, "Wow, Daddy! The garage is so much bigger now!" 
That night, Daddy went to bed feeling very alert. He was happy that he could make Mommy happy by increasing the size of the garage. He knew that they would have more space for their things now. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a daddy who had a daughter. The daughter was very happy and loved to play with her toys. One day, the mommy and daddy told the daughter that they were going to take her to the park. The daughter was very excited and couldn't wait to go.
But then, the mommy and daddy had to delay the trip to the park because it started to rain. The daughter was sad because she wanted to go to the park so badly. The mommy and daddy promised that they would take her to the park as soon as the rain stopped.
After a while, the rain stopped and the mommy and daddy took the daughter to the park. But when they got there, they saw something weird. All the swings were missing! The daughter was confused and didn't understand why the swings were gone. The mommy and daddy explained that sometimes things can be weird and unexpected, but they can still have fun and play in other ways. And so, the daughter played on the slide and had a great time at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go on adventures with her family. One day, they went on a trip in their car. Lily sat in the back seat with her brother, Max. 
As they drove down the road, Lily noticed a noisy sound coming from the trunk. "What's that noise?" she asked her mom. "It's probably just some things bouncing around in the trunk," her mom replied. 
Lily and Max were curious, so they asked if they could see what was in the trunk. Their dad pulled over and opened the trunk. They saw lots of bags and boxes, but one box was making the noisy sound. 
When they opened the box, they found a toy car that Max had forgotten to put away properly. "I'm sorry," Max said. "I didn't know it would be so noisy." Lily forgave him and they all continued on their adventure, happy to have solved the mystery of the noisy trunk.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved summer because he could play outside all day long. One day, Timmy went to the park and saw a little girl sitting alone on a bench. Timmy went to talk to her and asked if she wanted to play with him. The little girl was shy at first, but Timmy was patient and waited for her to feel comfortable. They played together all day and had so much fun. From that day on, they became best friends and played together every summer.

Once upon a time, there was an old lady. She was very old and her hair was white like snow. She lived in a big house with a garden full of flowers. One day, she went to the classroom to teach the children. The classroom was big and had lots of toys.
The old lady taught the children how to read and write. They all loved her because she was kind and funny. Suddenly, the phone rang and the old lady had to answer it. It was her daughter calling to check on her. The children waited patiently while the old lady talked on the phone.
After the call, the old lady said goodbye to the children and went back to her house. She was happy because she had a good day with the children in the classroom. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat avocados, they were her favorite food. One day, Lily and her mom went to the grocery store to buy some avocados. They picked a bright green one and brought it home.
When they got home, Lily's little brother Jack was playing with his toys. Lily wanted to show Jack the avocado and said, "Look Jack, we got a big green avocado!" Jack looked up and yelled, "Wow, it's so big!"
Lily's mom cut the avocado and they all had some for a snack. It was very yummy and they all smiled. Lily said, "I love avocados!" and Jack yelled, "Me too!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch the sunset every day with her mommy. One day, as they were watching the sunset, Lily fell asleep. When she woke up, the sun had already set and it was dark outside.
Lily started to cry because she missed the sunset. Her mommy hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. The sunset will come again tomorrow." Lily's mommy was very compassionate and always knew how to make her feel better.
From that day on, Lily made sure to stay awake and watch the sunset every day. She learned that sometimes we miss things when we're not paying attention, but we can always try again tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved flowers and had a pretty vase in her room. One day, her mom asked her to wash the vase. Lily didn't want to do it because she was feeling grumpy. But her mom said it was important to keep the vase clean so the flowers would stay healthy. 
Lily took the vase to the sink and used soap and water to wash it. It was hard work, but she did it all by herself. When she was finished, she felt proud of herself for doing a good job. 
Later that day, Lily's mom brought home some beautiful flowers and put them in the vase. Lily smiled and felt happy. She realized that washing the vase was worth it because it made her room look pretty and made her feel good inside.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Lily. She loved playing outside and exploring the earth. One day, she found a big rock that she wanted to turn into a special present for her mommy. She thought and thought about how to design it just right.
But then, a naughty squirrel came along and tried to steal the rock! Lily was upset and scared. She didn't want to lose her special present for her mommy. But then, she remembered to be grateful for all the other rocks and pretty things she had found on earth. She decided to let the squirrel have the rock and be happy with what she had. And in the end, Lily still made a beautiful present for her mommy with all the other treasures she found.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max loved to play with his friends at the park. They would run and jump and laugh together. 
One day, Max's friend Spot invited him to a lab. Max was curious and excited to see what a lab was. When he got there, he saw lots of beakers and test tubes. Spot's owner was a scientist and she was doing experiments. 
Max and Spot started to play a game of fetch in the lab. They were both very competitive and wanted to win. Max threw the ball far and Spot ran to get it. They both laughed when Spot accidentally knocked over a beaker. Luckily, nothing broke and they continued to play. Max had a great time at the lab with his friend Spot.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her yard. One day, she was playing with her ball, and it went over the fence. She said, "Oh no, my ball is gone!"
Her mommy asked her, "What's wrong, Lily?"
"My ball is gone. It went over the fence," Lily said.
"Don't worry, we'll get it back," her mommy said.
They went to the fence and Lily's mommy lifted her up so she could see over it. She saw her ball and said, "Yay! Thank you, mommy. I missed my ball."
When they got back inside, Lily's mommy gave her a delicious snack. Lily said, "Yum! This is delicious. Thank you, mommy."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved ice-cream, especially the famous kind that her mom bought for her. One day, Lily went to the park with her mom and saw her friends playing hide-and-seek. She wanted to play too!
Lily's mom said, "Sure, you can play hide-and-seek with your friends, but be careful not to hide too far away."
Lily ran to hide behind a big tree, but she got scared because it was dark and she couldn't see anything. She started to cry and called out for her mom.
Her mom heard her and came to find her. She said, "It's okay, Lily. You don't have to hide if you don't want to. The most important thing is that you're safe and happy."
Lily learned that it's okay to try new things, but it's also important to listen to her feelings and not do things that make her uncomfortable. From that day on, Lily played with her friends, ate her favorite famous ice-cream, and had lots of fun at the park. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a purple dress that she loved to wear. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends. While they were playing, Lily saw a butterfly that was also purple. She said, "Look, a purple butterfly! I want to watch it." 
Her friend Emma said, "I want to watch it too!" They both sat down and watched the butterfly together. After a while, Lily said, "I'm tired. I want to sleep now." Emma said, "Okay, let's go home and take a nap." 
When they got home, Lily put on her purple pajamas and went to bed. She said goodnight to her mom and dad, and soon she was fast asleep. She dreamed about the purple butterfly and how much fun she had watching it with Emma. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, she saw a butterfly flying in the sky. It was so pretty and colorful. Lily wanted to catch it and perform a dance with it.
She ran after the butterfly, but it was too fast. Suddenly, the butterfly landed on a clear flower. Lily was so happy! She gently held the butterfly and performed her dance. The butterfly flapped its wings and flew away.
Lily was sad that the butterfly left, but she was happy that she got to perform with it. She knew that she would see more butterflies in the future.

Once upon a time, there was a big elephant named Ellie. Ellie was very tidy and always kept her room clean. One day, her friend monkey came to visit her. Monkey said, "Ellie, your room is so tidy! Can you teach me how to tidy my room too?" Ellie replied, "Sure, I can serve as your teacher and show you how to tidy up."
Ellie started teaching Monkey how to tidy up his room. She said, "First, we need to pick up all the toys and put them in their proper place. Then, we need to make the bed and fold the blankets. Finally, we need to sweep the floor and make sure everything is in its right weight." Monkey was happy to learn and said, "Thank you, Ellie! You are such a great teacher." 
Ellie smiled and said, "It was my pleasure to serve as your teacher. Now, let's have some fun and play with our toys!" The two friends played and had a great time in Ellie's tidy room. From that day on, Monkey always kept his room tidy just like Ellie's.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty dress and loved to play outside. One day, Lily's mom asked her to go to the store to buy some sugar.
Lily was excited to go to the store, but when she got there, she saw a big line. The line was very long, and it made her feel sad because it would delay her from getting home to play.
She waited patiently in line and finally got the sugar. On her way back home, she met her friend, Timmy. Timmy said, "Wow, Lily, your dress is so pretty!" Lily smiled and replied, "Thanks, I went to the store to get some sugar, but the line was so long that it delayed me." Timmy said, "That's okay, let's go play!" And they ran off to play together.

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy named Spot. Spot loved to play and chase his tail. One day, Spot went for a walk with his owner, Sarah. Sarah let Spot off his leash so he could run and play. Spot was having so much fun that he didn't notice when Sarah started to leave.
"Spot, come on! We have to go home now," Sarah called.
Spot didn't want to leave yet, but he knew he had to go with Sarah. He wagged his tail happily and followed her home.
When they got home, Sarah gave Spot a treat. Spot was so grateful that he licked Sarah's face. "Thank you for the treat!" Spot barked happily.
Sarah smiled and scratched Spot's tail. "You're welcome, Spot. I'm grateful to have you as my puppy."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a cup that she loved to drink juice from every day. The cup was dependable and never spilled.
One day, Lily went to the park with her mom and brought her cup with her. She played on the swings and the slide, but then she noticed her cup was missing. She asked her mom if she had seen it, but her mom questioned her and said she didn't know.
Lily looked everywhere for her cup, but she couldn't find it. She felt sad and didn't want to play anymore. When it was time to go home, Lily still didn't have her cup. She cried all the way home. It was a bad ending to a fun day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and dolls. One day, Lily's mom asked her if she wanted to have a fancy tea party with her dolls. Lily was very excited and said yes.
Lily's mom provided all the things they needed for the tea party. She brought out the tea cups, saucers, and a fancy teapot. They sat down and enjoyed their tea and cookies.
Suddenly, Lily saw some smoke coming from the kitchen. She got scared and ran to her mom. Her mom told her not to worry and that she would take care of it. She quickly put out the fire and everything was okay.
After the tea party, Lily's mom told her that it's important to always be careful with fire and to never play with matches or lighters. Lily learned that it's important to listen to her mom and always be safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing in the park and looking at the fountain. The fountain was big and had water that went up and down. Timmy liked to watch the water go up and down slowly.
One day, Timmy saw a girl at the park. She looked sad and lonely. Timmy wanted to be her friend, but she didn't want to play with him. She ignored him and walked away. Timmy felt sad too.
Later that day, Timmy was playing near the fountain when he saw the girl again. She was trying to throw a coin in the fountain, but she couldn't reach. Timmy remembered how she ignored him earlier, but he still wanted to help her. He went over and helped her throw the coin in the fountain. The girl smiled and said thank you. Timmy felt happy that he helped her and they became friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the park. One day, Timmy's mom told him they were going on a camping trip. Timmy was very excited! 
As they were packing, Timmy's mom reminded him to bring his flashlight. Timmy grabbed his flashlight and put it in his backpack. 
When they arrived at the campsite, Timmy wanted to explore right away. He saw a beautiful lake and wanted to go swimming. But his mom told him they needed to set up the tent first. Timmy was impatient and wanted to hurry up, but he knew he had to help his mom. 
That night, when it got dark, Timmy was glad he brought his flashlight. They used it to find their way back to the tent. Timmy realized that it was important to be patient and listen to his mom's advice. He learned that sometimes it's bitter to wait, but it's worth it in the end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his football. His football was the most special thing he had. One day, Timmy went to play with his friends in the park. But when he got there, he realized he forgot to unlock his door. 
Timmy was very sad because he couldn't play with his football. He tried to open the door, but it was locked. Suddenly, he remembered that his dad had given him a special key to unlock the door. Timmy found the key and unlocked the door. 
He was so happy that he could finally play with his ordinary football. Timmy and his friends played for hours until it was time to go home. Timmy went to bed that night feeling very proud of himself for unlocking the door and getting to play with his football.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo. Nemo loved to swim in the ocean with his friends. One day, Nemo met a friendly surfing crab named Crabby. Crabby said, "Come surf with me, Nemo! It's so much fun!" Nemo was scared at first, but he decided to try it.
Nemo and Crabby surfed the waves together and had a delicious picnic on the beach. But then, a big wave came and swept Nemo away. Nemo cried out for help, but it was too late. Nemo's friends were sad and learned a lesson: it's important to be careful and stay safe, even when having fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her colorful dress. One day, her mom noticed that Lily's dress was dirty and had a stain on it. 
Mom said, "Lily, we need to improve your dress. Let's wash it with soap and water." 
Lily replied, "Okay, Mommy. Can I help you wash it?" 
Mom said, "Of course, you can help me. First, we need to take off the dress and put it in the water with soap." 
Lily took off her dress and put it in the water. They washed the dress together and hung it up to dry. When the dress was dry, it looked clean and colorful again. 
Lily said, "Thank you, Mommy. My dress looks so pretty now." 
Mom replied, "You're welcome, Lily. Remember to take care of your clothes, so they stay colorful and clean."

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max was an ordinary dog with a brown collar. One day, Max went for a walk with his owner, Lily. They were having a good time until a big thunderstorm came.
Max was scared of the loud thunder and ran away from Lily. He ran and ran until he saw a cat. Max wanted to play with the cat, but the cat didn't want to play. The cat hissed at Max and Max got angry. He tried to strike the cat with his paw, but he missed.
Suddenly, a car came and hit Max. Lily came running and saw that Max was hurt. She took him to the vet, but it was too late. Max had passed away. Lily was very sad and wished Max had stayed with her instead of running away.

Once upon a time, there was a big house with a door. The door was brown and it could move when people opened it. One day, a little boy came to the house and he saw the impressive door. He wanted to open it and see what was inside. So he moved the door and went inside. Inside the house, he found a lot of toys to play with. He was very happy and he played with the toys all day. When it was time to go home, he moved the door again and went outside. He was very impressed by the big house and the amazing toys inside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play in the rain. She would jump in all the puddles and get very wet. One day, Lily saw a cute little frog hopping around in the rain.
"Hello little frog! What are you doing in the rain?" asked Lily.
"I like the rain because it helps create more puddles for me to swim in," replied the frog.
Lily smiled and said, "That's so cool! I love playing in the rain too. Do you want to play with me?"
The frog hopped up and down with excitement and said, "Yes, let's play together and create lots of fun puddles to jump in!"
So, Lily and the frog played together in the rain, creating lots of wet puddles to jump in. They had so much fun and became the best of friends. From that day on, whenever it rained, Lily and the cute little frog would play together and create new adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a little kitten named Mittens. Mittens was very popular with all the other animals in the forest because she was so cute and cuddly. One day, Mittens met a wise old owl who asked her, "Mittens, do you know what it means to weigh something?"
Mittens shook her head, "No, Mr. Owl. What does it mean?"
"To weigh something means to see how heavy it is," replied the owl. "You see, Mittens, it's not just about being popular or cute. It's also important to be strong and healthy. You should eat good food and exercise so you can weigh the right amount for your size."
Mittens listened carefully and realized that being healthy was just as important as being popular. From that day on, she made sure to eat well and play outside every day. And all the animals in the forest still loved her, not just because she was cute, but because she was strong and healthy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily had a teddy bear that she loved very much. One day, Lily lost her teddy bear and she was very sad. She looked everywhere for her teddy bear, but she couldn't find it. Lily started to feel anxious and worried that she would never find her teddy bear.
Lily's mommy saw that Lily was suffering because she lost her teddy bear. She tried to help Lily find her teddy bear, but they still couldn't find it. Then, Lily's daddy had an idea. He remembered that they went to the park yesterday and maybe the teddy bear was left there. They went to the park and found the teddy bear! Lily was so happy and she hugged her teddy bear tightly. She was no longer anxious and her smile came back. From that day on, Lily never let go of her teddy bear again.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Benny. Benny loved to eat honey from the beehive. One day, Benny found out that he had a cavity in his tooth. His friend, a wise owl named Ollie, told him that eating too much honey was not good for his teeth. Ollie suggested that Benny should eat more minerals to prevent cavities.
Benny asked, "What are minerals?" 
Ollie replied, "Minerals are things like rocks and stones that are good for your body."
Benny listened to Ollie's advice and started eating more minerals like rocks and stones. He also ate less honey and his cavity went away. Benny was happy and thanked Ollie for his help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved waking up early to see the sunrise. One day, she woke up and saw that the sky was yellow. She was very happy because she knew that meant the sunrise would be extra pretty.
Lily went outside to watch the sunrise with her mom. "Look, Mommy! The sunrise is so pretty today!" Lily said. "Yes, it is," her mom replied. "The yellow sky provides a beautiful background for the sunrise."
Lily and her mom sat and watched the sunrise together. They talked about how the sun makes everything warm and bright. Lily was so happy to spend the morning with her mom and see the beautiful yellow sunrise.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim liked to play with his wagon. His wagon was red and it was light, so Tim could pull it easily. 
One day, Tim went to the park with his wagon. He played with his friends and they had fun. But when it was time to go home, Tim realized that he had lost his favorite toy. He looked everywhere, but he couldn't find it.
Tim's mom saw that he was sad and asked him what was wrong. Tim told her about his lost wagon. His mom said they would go back to the park and look for it.
When they got to the park, Tim saw a man with a sack. The man had found Tim's wagon and put it in the sack to keep it safe. Tim was happy to have his wagon back and thanked the man. He put his wagon in the back of the car and they went home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the snow. One day, Lily decided to have a picnic for lunch. She packed a sandwich, some fruit, and a juice box.
As she was eating her lunch, Lily saw a squirrel running by. She wanted to share her lunch with the squirrel, so she threw a piece of bread to him. Suddenly, the squirrel stopped and froze. Lily was confused and didn't know why the squirrel wasn't moving.
Then, Lily realized that the squirrel was trying to hide the bread in his cheeks because he was rich and wanted to save it for later. Lily laughed and continued to enjoy her lunch in the snow.

Once upon a time, there was a man who had no hair on his head. He was bald. One day, he wanted to go to the store to buy some candy. But he had to delay his trip because he had a toothache. He was sad because he really wanted some candy. 
He decided to go to the dentist to fix his tooth. The dentist was very nice and fixed his tooth. The man was happy because he could finally go to the store to buy some candy. He put on his hat to cover his bald head and went to the store. He bought lots of candy and shared it with his friends. They all had a great time eating candy together. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to read. He had a big book with lots of pictures and words. One day, he went outside to play and saw a pile of leaves. He wanted to jump in them, but they were too messy. 
Timmy's mom came outside and saw the leaves. "We need to rake these leaves," she said. "Can you help me, Timmy?" Timmy was brave and said yes. They worked together and raked all the leaves into a big pile. 
Then, Timmy's little sister came outside and wanted to jump in the pile. But Timmy said no because they worked hard to make it neat. His sister got upset and started to cry. Timmy felt bad, so he read her a story from his book. She stopped crying and they all played together in the leaves. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a fat squirrel. He loved to eat nuts and seeds. One day, he wanted to prepare for winter. He gathered lots of nuts and put them in his tree house. The squirrel was happy because he knew he would have enough food to eat during the cold winter months.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved music and wanted to play a trumpet. Timmy's mom bought him a trumpet, but he didn't know how to play it. He blew into the trumpet, but it just made a loud noise. Timmy was confused and sad.
One day, Timmy went to the park and met a man playing the trumpet. The man played so well that everyone in the park stopped to listen. Timmy went up to the man and said, "I want to play the trumpet like you, but I don't know how." The man smiled and said, "It takes practice and patience. You have to resist giving up."
That night, Timmy practiced playing the trumpet. He tried and tried, but it still sounded bad. He was about to give up, but he remembered what the man had said. He resisted giving up and kept practicing. After a few weeks, Timmy's trumpet playing got better and he was able to play a song. He felt so proud and happy that he could play the trumpet like the man in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends. While she was playing, she found a shiny rock on the ground. She picked it up and showed it to her friends. "Look at this pretty rock I found!" she said.
One of her friends said, "That's not just any rock, it's a mineral! My dad told me about them. They come from deep underground and are very rare." Lily was fascinated by the mineral and decided to keep it in her pocket.
Later that day, Lily was walking home when she heard a loud noise. She looked around and saw a big dog running towards her. She was frightened and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, the mineral in her pocket started to glow and the dog stopped in its tracks. Lily realized that the mineral had magical powers and it saved her from the scary dog.
When she got home, she told her mom about the mineral and how it helped her. Her mom was amazed and proud of her brave daughter. From that day on, Lily kept the mineral with her wherever she went, knowing that it would always come to her rescue if she was ever frightened again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily was very enthusiastic about playing with her toys every day. She loved to play with her dolls, her blocks, and her teddy bear. One day, Lily's mom took her to the park to play with other kids. Lily was very happy and excited to play with the other kids.
While playing, Lily saw a little boy who was sad and crying. She went to him and asked, "Why are you crying?" The little boy said, "I lost my toy car, and I can't find it." Lily felt sad for the little boy, so she decided to help him. She asked the other kids to help her find the toy car. After a while, they found the toy car stuck in a tree. Lily climbed the tree and released the toy car from the branches.
The little boy was very patient and waited for Lily to find his toy car. He was very happy when he got it back. Lily learned that it's important to help others and be patient when waiting for something. She felt happy that she could make the little boy smile again. From that day on, Lily always tried to help others and be patient when waiting for things. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his blocks. He would build towers and castles all day long. Timmy was very creative with his blocks.
One day, Timmy's mom called him for lunch. Timmy was so excited to eat his favorite sandwich. But when he went back to his room to play with his blocks, they were gone! Timmy looked everywhere, but they had disappeared.
Timmy was sad, but he didn't give up. He used his creative mind to think of a way to find his blocks. Suddenly, he remembered that he had let his friend borrow them. Timmy went to his friend's house and there they were - his blocks! Timmy was so happy to have his blocks back and he knew he would never let them disappear again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited to go to her grandma's house. She packed her bag and went to the car with her mom and dad. They drove for a long time and finally arrived at grandma's house.
When they got inside, Lily saw a big cupboard in the kitchen. She asked her grandma, "What's in the cupboard?" Her grandma replied, "That's where I keep all my dishes and cups."
Lily was grateful when her grandma gave her a cup to drink from. She said, "Thank you, grandma! This cup is so pretty." They all sat down and had some cookies and milk. Lily was very happy to be with her family and couldn't wait to come back again.

Once upon a time, there was a fireman named Jack. Jack was always very hungry because he worked hard to put out fires. One day, Jack was eating his lunch when a little boy came up to him and asked, "Can I add some ketchup to your sandwich?"
Jack said, "Sure, that would be great!" The little boy added ketchup to Jack's sandwich and they started talking. The little boy said, "I want to be a fireman like you when I grow up."
Jack smiled and said, "That's great! We need more firemen to help keep people safe."
Later that day, Jack got a call that there was a big fire at a nearby building. He rushed over to help, but unfortunately, he didn't make it out. The little boy was sad when he heard the news, but he knew that Jack was a hero who had helped many people.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her pink ball. One day, Lily went for a walk in the park. She saw a charming butterfly and tried to catch it, but it flew away. 
Suddenly, she heard a loud noise. It was a car that zoomed past her. Lily was scared and ran to hide behind a tree. She peeked through the branches and saw a dog running after the car. 
Lily felt sad for the dog, so she called him over. The dog was friendly and licked her face. Lily petted him and they became friends. From that day on, Lily and the dog played together in the park every day. They would chase after the pink ball and sometimes even try to catch the charming butterfly.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to travel to different places and see new things. One day, he went on a trip with his mommy and daddy. They packed everything they needed in a big, brown barrel.
During the trip, Timmy felt uncomfortable because he was sitting for a long time in the car. "Mommy, my bottom hurts. Can we stop and take a break?" Timmy asked. "Sure thing, Timmy. Let's find a nice spot to rest," his mommy replied.
They found a cozy picnic area where they could stretch their legs and have some snacks. Timmy felt much better and happy to continue their journey. "I like traveling with you guys. It's fun!" Timmy said with a big smile. His mommy and daddy smiled back, happy to hear their little boy's excitement.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play outside in the sunshine with her dog. One day, while they were playing, Lily discovered a pretty rock. She picked it up and showed it to her dog. 
Later that day, Lily's mom showed her an image of a butterfly in a book. Lily thought it was very beautiful and wanted to see a real butterfly. So, she went outside to look for one. After a while, she saw a butterfly flying around in the garden. She was very happy to have discovered it.
Lily was a very compassionate girl. When she saw her friend crying, she gave her a hug and told her everything would be okay. Her friend felt much better after that. Lily learned that being kind and caring can make others feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play in the water. He would jump and splash in the big puddles after it rained. One day, Timmy went to the beach with his mommy and daddy. They brought a big flag to put in the sand. Timmy loved the flag because it was red and had white stripes. He thought it was so pretty. But then, a big wave came and splashed Timmy and the flag. The water was bad and salty, and Timmy didn't like it. But he still loved playing in the sand and watching the flag wave in the wind. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a farmer who loved to grow corn. He had a big field where he planted lots of corn. One day, a big wind came and made all the corn move back and forth. The farmer was happy to see it because he knew it meant the corn was growing well.
One day, the farmer saw a bird with a bald head. The bird was looking for food in the cornfield. The farmer felt sorry for the bird because it looked hungry. So, he decided to share some of his corn with the bird. The bird was very happy and ate all the corn.
From that day on, the bird would come to the cornfield every day to eat. The farmer was happy to see the bird and the bird was happy to eat the corn. And every time the wind blew, the corn would move and the bird would dance with joy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited to go on an adventure with her mommy. They went to a big building with lots of floors. They went inside an elevator to go up to the top floor. 
But then, the elevator stopped moving and they were stuck. Lily started to feel scared and silly. She didn't know what to do. Her mommy tried to call for help, but her phone didn't work in the elevator. 
Lily remembered a game she played where she had to sit still and be quiet. She told her mommy and they both sat quietly together. Soon, they heard a noise and the elevator started moving again. They made it to the top floor and had a great adventure, but they never forgot the silly elevator ride.

Once upon a time, there was a rabbit named Bob. Bob was very lazy and never wanted to do anything. One day, Bob's friend, a squirrel named Sally, came to visit him. Sally brought some vegetables to share with Bob.
Bob looked at the vegetables and said, "No, thank you. I don't want to eat vegetables. They're yucky."
Sally replied, "But vegetables are good for you. They make you strong and healthy."
Bob thought about it for a moment and decided to try some vegetables. He realized they were actually quite tasty! From that day on, Bob started eating vegetables and became stronger and healthier.
The moral of the story is that it's important to share and try new things, even if we don't think we'll like them at first.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to her friend's house for a meal. Her friend's mom was very polite and asked Lily what she wanted to eat. Lily said she wanted spaghetti and meatballs. 
While they were eating, Lily heard a strange noise. She asked her friend, "Do you hear that?" Her friend listened carefully and said, "I don't hear anything." But Lily kept listening and realized it was the sound of a cat meowing outside. 
Lily told her friend's mom about the cat and they went outside to find it. They found the cat and gave it some food. The cat was very happy and started purring. Lily felt happy too because she helped the cat. After that, they went back inside and finished their meal. It was a fun day for Lily!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved to drive his toy car around the house. One day, he went to the park with his mom and dad. They played on the swings and slides. Timmy loved the rhythm of the swings.
After playing, they went to get ice cream. Timmy wanted a smelly flavor, like stinky cheese. But his mom and dad said no, so he chose chocolate instead. They drove home in their car, singing songs and laughing.
Suddenly, a big truck crashed into their car. Timmy was scared and hurt. His mom and dad were hurt too. They went to the hospital, but the doctors couldn't save them. Timmy was now alone and sad. He missed his mom and dad very much.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a red bike with a big wheel in the front. He loved to ride his bike all around the park, but today he was feeling restless. 
As Timmy rode his bike, he saw a big dog who started to bark loudly. The dog scared Timmy, so he yelled for help. His mom heard him and came running over to see what was wrong. 
Timmy's mom saw the big dog and told him to stay still. She went over to the dog and petted him gently. The dog stopped barking and Timmy felt much better. He got back on his bike and rode around the park, feeling happy and safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a best friend named Timmy. They loved to play together all the time. One day, Timmy wanted to play with his toy trucks, but Lily wanted to play with her dolls. 
Timmy said, "I don't want to play with dolls. Let's play with my trucks." 
Lily felt sad because she really wanted to play with her dolls. But then she had an idea. "Let's complete our own game. We can play with your trucks and my dolls. It will be fun!" 
Timmy thought it was a good idea and they played together happily. Lily was happy that she didn't have to give up playing with her dolls and Timmy was happy that he could play with his trucks too. They were both friends and didn't want to be bossy to each other. They knew that playing together and being happy was more important than being bossy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to play with his toys. He had a favorite old teddy bear that he always carried with him. One day, Timmy's friend Jimmy came over to play. Jimmy saw the old teddy bear and said, "That toy is not cool. I don't like it."
Timmy felt sad and said, "I disagree. My teddy bear is very special to me. It has a lot of value because it was a gift from my grandma."
Jimmy thought about it and said, "You're right. I'm sorry for saying that. Maybe I can play with your teddy bear too."
Timmy smiled and said, "That's okay. We can share it." They played together happily with the old teddy bear and had a lot of fun. From then on, Jimmy understood the value of old toys and never disagreed with Timmy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with glue and make pretty pictures. One day, Lily's friend came over to play. They started to make a big picture together, but it was difficult to stick all the pieces together.
Lily's friend said, "I don't want to play anymore. This is too difficult." But Lily did not want to give up. She said, "Let's keep trying. We can do it!" 
After a while, they finally finished the picture. Lily's friend was so happy and said, "You were right, Lily. We did it! I'm sorry I lied and said it was too difficult." 
Lily forgave her friend and they had lots of fun playing with glue and making more pictures together.

Once upon a time, there was a furry puppy named Max. Max loved to run and play in the park. One day, Max saw a big plane flying in the sky.
Max barked excitedly, "Look, look! Plane up high!"
His owner, Lily, smiled and said, "Yes, Max. That's a plane. It's flying very far away."
Max wagged his tail and ran around in circles. He was so happy to see the big, shiny plane up in the sky. From that day on, Max would always look up at the sky, hoping to see another plane fly by.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, Lily and her friends went to the park to play hide and seek. 
Lily found a long towel on the ground and decided to hide behind it. Suddenly, she heard a voice saying, "I found you!" It was her friend, Tim. 
Lily giggled and said, "You're good at finding me, Tim." 
After playing for a while, it was time to go home. Lily's mom came to pick her up and said, "Let's go home, Lily. Don't forget to lock the door." 
Lily nodded and said, "Okay, Mommy. I will lock the door." 
And so, Lily and her mom went home, happy and tired from a fun day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy who loved to play with balls. One day, he found a big, red ball in the park. He threw it up high and caught it with a big smile on his face. 
Suddenly, a girl named Sally came over and asked, "Can I play with your ball?" Timmy replied, "No, it's mine." Sally looked sad and said, "I don't have any toys to play with."
Timmy felt bad and decided to share his ball with Sally. They played together for a while until the ball accidentally hit a ball of yarn that was lying nearby. The yarn started to unravel and Timmy and Sally didn't know what to do. 
They tried to put the yarn back together, but it was too tangled and unknown how to fix it. They decided to go ask Timmy's mom for help. She was able to untangle the yarn and they all laughed and played together happily.

Once upon a time, there was a nice man who had a red shirt. He liked to wear his shirt when he went outside to play. One day, he saw a little girl who was sad because she lost her ball. The man wanted to help her, so he gently asked her where she last saw it. She said she thought she saw it pass by the tree. The man looked and found the ball! The little girl was happy and gave the man a big hug. He smiled and went back to his house, feeling good that he could help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and paint all day long. One day, her mom said, "Lily, it's time to shut off the TV and do something creative." 
Lily got out her paints and started to draw a picture of a flower. She loved to use lots of colors and make her pictures very pretty. Suddenly, her mom said, "Lily, can you hear that bird singing outside?" 
Lily listened and heard the bird too. She said, "Yes, mommy. It's singing a pretty song." Her mom replied, "That's right, Lily. It's nice to use our ears and listen to the sounds around us." 
Lily finished her painting and showed it to her mom. Her mom said, "Wow, Lily! You're so creative. I love your painting." Lily smiled and said, "Thanks, mommy. I love to draw and paint."

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved motorcycles and he always dreamed of having one. One day, he saw a man riding a big motorcycle and he asked him, "Can I ride your motorcycle?" The man replied, "No, it's not safe for a little boy like you."
Timmy was sad and tired of waiting to ride a motorcycle. Then, he met a girl named Lily. They became good friends and Timmy told her about his dream of riding a motorcycle. Lily said, "I know someone who can help you. He's my uncle and he has a motorcycle. Maybe he can teach you how to ride it."
Timmy was so happy and grateful to Lily. He went to meet her uncle and he taught him how to ride the motorcycle safely. Timmy was so excited that he said, "Lily, when I grow up, I'm going to marry you for being such a good friend and helping me achieve my dream." Lily smiled and said, "I'm happy to be your friend forever." The moral of the story is that true friendship can help you achieve your dreams.

Once upon a time, a big volcano lived on a mountain. It was very hot and had red, orange, and yellow colors. One day, a little boy named Timmy come to see the volcano. He was very excited and happy. Timmy loved the colors and the sound of the volcano.
Suddenly, the volcano started to shake and make loud noises. Timmy got scared and started to run. But the volcano was fit and didn't want to hurt Timmy. So, it stopped shaking and became quiet. Timmy was very happy and came back to see the volcano again. From that day on, Timmy and the volcano became good friends.

Once upon a time, a bird wanted to fly high in the sky. It had pretty feathers and was very graceful. The bird wanted to show off its beauty to all the other animals. So, it took off and flew higher and higher.
But suddenly, a big wind came and the bird couldn't fly anymore. It started to fall down, down, down. A cat saw the bird falling and quickly ran to take it in its paws.
The bird was hurt and couldn't fly anymore. It was very sad and missed flying high in the sky. From that day on, the bird stayed on the ground and never flew again.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys and books. They also like to make jokes and tricks. One day, they find a big box in the living room. It has a bow and a tag. The tag says: "To Anna and Ben, from Santa".
Anna and Ben are very happy. They think Santa came early this year. They want to open the box and see what is inside. But they also want to wait for Christmas. They are confused. What should they do?
They decide to make a plan. They will open the box very carefully and see what is inside. Then they will wrap it again and put it back. They will act surprised on Christmas. They think this is a good joke.
They open the box and see a big teddy bear. It is soft and brown. It has a red scarf and a hat. Anna and Ben love it. They hug it and play with it. They forget about their plan. They forget about the time.
Mom and Dad come home. They see Anna and Ben with the teddy bear. They see the box and the paper. They are not happy. They are angry. They ask Anna and Ben what they did. Anna and Ben are scared. They try to lie. They say they found the teddy bear outside. They say they did not open the box.
Mom and Dad know the truth. They are not stupid. They tell Anna and Ben that they are naughty. They tell them that they broke the rule. They tell them that they have to say sorry. They tell them that they have to give back the teddy bear. They tell them that they have to wait for Christmas.
Anna and Ben are sad. They cry. They say sorry. They give back the teddy bear. They wrap it again and put it back. They learn their lesson. They do not make jokes and tricks with presents. They do not lie to Mom and Dad. They wait for Christmas. They hope Santa will forgive them.

Anna liked to examine things. She liked to look at them and touch them and ask questions. She wanted to know how they worked and why they were different. She examined her toys, her books, her clothes, and her pets.
One day, she decided to examine the bathtub. She climbed on a stool and looked inside. She saw water, soap, bubbles, and a rubber duck. She touched the water and felt it was warm. She touched the soap and felt it was slippery. She touched the bubbles and felt them pop. She touched the rubber duck and felt it squeak.
She thought the bathtub was attractive. It was shiny and white and had pretty patterns on the tiles. She liked the colors and the shapes. She liked how the water sparkled and the bubbles floated. She liked how the rubber duck smiled and the soap smelled.
She wanted to play in the bathtub. She took off her clothes and jumped in. She splashed and laughed and made more bubbles. She hugged the rubber duck and washed it with the soap. She had fun in the bathtub.
She did not hear her mom calling her. She did not see her mom coming in. She did not notice her mom's face. She only noticed her mom's voice when she said, "Anna, what are you doing? You are making a mess! You are supposed to examine things with your eyes, not with your whole body!"

Anna and Ben were friends who liked to play in the garden. They had a small plant that they watered every day. The plant had green leaves and purple flowers.
One day, Anna was feeling bossy. She wanted to water the plant by herself. She said to Ben, "Go away, this is my plant. You can't touch it."
Ben was sad and angry. He said, "No, it is our plant. We share it. You are not nice."
Anna and Ben started to fight. They pulled the plant from each other. The plant was hurt. Some of the leaves and flowers fell off.
Anna and Ben stopped fighting. They saw the plant and felt sorry. They said to the plant, "We are sorry, plant. We did not mean to hurt you. Please forgive us."
The plant did not say anything. But it still looked alive. Anna and Ben decided to be nice to each other and to the plant. They hugged and said, "We are friends. We share the plant. We are not bossy."
They watered the plant together and put it in a sunny spot. The plant was happy. It grew new leaves and flowers. Anna and Ben were happy too. They played in the garden and took care of the plant. They learned to forgive and share.

Ben and Mia were playing in the park with their bikes. They liked to ride fast and make noises. They saw a big hill and wanted to go down it.
"Let's race!" Ben said. "I bet I can go faster than you!"
"OK!" Mia said. "But be careful. There is a cable at the bottom of the hill. It is for the lights. We have to stop before we hit it."
They got ready and started to pedal. They went down the hill very fast. They felt the wind in their hair and the sun on their faces. They laughed and shouted.
But Ben did not listen to Mia. He wanted to win. He did not look at the cable. He did not stop. He hit the cable with his bike. He fell off and hurt his leg. He started to scream.
Mia stopped and ran to him. She saw the blood on his leg. She felt sorry for him. She said, "Ben, why did you not stop? I told you about the cable. You were not wise. You were silly. Now you are hurt."
Ben cried and said, "I'm sorry, Mia. I wanted to win. I did not think. You were wise. You were careful. Can you help me?"
Mia nodded and said, "Yes, I can help you. But first, we have to call Mom. She will know what to do. She will take you to the doctor. He will make your leg better."
She took out her phone and called Mom. She told her what happened. Mom said she would come right away. She told them to stay where they were and not to move.
Mia hugged Ben and said, "Don't worry, Ben. It will be OK. Mom is coming. She will help you. And I will stay with you. You are my brother. I love you."
Ben smiled and said, "Thank you, Mia. You are my sister. I love you too."

Anna and Ben were playing in the park. They liked to look at the sky and see the clouds. They saw many shapes in the clouds. They saw a bunny, a car, a flower and a star.
"Look, Ben, that cloud looks like a bunny!" Anna said, pointing at the sky.
"I see it, Anna, it has long ears and a fluffy tail!" Ben said, smiling.
They looked for more clouds that looked like things they knew. They recognized a car, a flower and a star. They were having fun.
Then they saw a big cloud that looked like nothing. It was just a big, white, fluffy cloud. It covered the sun and made the sky darker.
"What is that cloud, Anna?" Ben asked, feeling scared.
"I don't know, Ben, it is a strange cloud. Maybe it is a monster cloud!" Anna said, feeling scared too.
They hugged each other and wished the cloud would go away. They did not like the strange cloud.
But then the wind blew and the cloud moved. The sun came out again and made the sky bright and blue. The strange cloud was gone.
"Look, Ben, the sky is beautiful again!" Anna said, feeling happy.
"Yes, Anna, it is. And look, there is a rainbow!" Ben said, feeling happy too.
They saw the rainbow with many colors. They recognized red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple. They liked the rainbow. It was a beautiful cloud. They smiled and clapped their hands. They were not scared anymore. They were happy.

Lily and Ben were playing in the garden. They liked to observe the bugs and the flowers. They saw a big mushroom under a tree. It was brown and round and had spots on it.
"Look, a mushroom!" Lily said. "Can we touch it?"
"I don't know," Ben said. "Maybe it is not good to touch. Mom said some mushrooms are bad."
Lily wanted to touch it anyway. She reached out her hand and poked the mushroom. It felt soft and wet. But then the mushroom broke and fell apart. Lily gasped.
"Oh no!" Ben said. "You broke the mushroom! What if it was someone's home? What if a bug lived there?"
Lily felt sorry. She did not mean to break the mushroom. She did not know it was so fragile. She looked at the pieces of the mushroom on the ground. She saw a small worm crawling out of one of them. She felt even more sorry.
"I'm sorry, worm," she said. "I'm sorry, mushroom. I did not want to hurt you. I was just curious."
Ben saw that Lily was sorry. He hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. You did not know. Maybe we can find another mushroom for the worm. Maybe we can help it find a new home."
Lily nodded. She wiped her tears and smiled. She and Ben looked around the garden for another mushroom. They found one that was smaller and white and had no spots. They carefully picked it up and brought it to the worm. They placed it near the broken mushroom and hoped the worm would like it.
"Here you go, worm," Lily said. "This is a new mushroom for you. We hope you are happy. We are sorry for breaking your old mushroom."
The worm wiggled and seemed to say thank you. Lily and Ben felt happy. They learned to be more careful with the things they observe. They also learned to say sorry when they make a mistake. They went back to playing in the garden, but they did not touch any more mushrooms. They just looked at them and admired their colors and shapes.

Ben and Mia like to play in the big room with many books and papers. They see a big box with a lock on it. They want to know what is inside. They look for a key, but they cannot find one. They see a metal thing that looks like a stick. It is a file. They think it can open the lock.
They take the file and try to put it in the lock. They push and pull, but nothing happens. They hear a loud noise. It is a beep. They look at the box. It has a red light and a number. The number is going down. 10, 9, 8...
They do not know what it means. They are scared. They tremble. They want to run away, but they do not know how. The door is locked too. They scream for help, but no one hears them. The number is going down. 3, 2, 1...
The box explodes. It makes a big fire and a big boom. It hurts Ben and Mia. They fall down and do not get up. The box was dangerous. It was a bomb. Someone put it there to hurt people. Ben and Mia did not know. They just wanted to play. They are gone. The end.

Lily and Ben are playing in the living room. They see a letter on the table. It is for their mom. Lily wants to open it. She is curious.
"Let me see, let me see!" she says. She grabs the letter and tries to tear it.
"No, no, no!" Ben says. He is careful. He knows mom will be angry if they open her letter. He tries to take the letter from Lily.
They pull and tug. The letter rips. They hear a loud noise. It is mom. She is coming.
They hide the letter under the couch. They pretend to play with their toys. Mom enters the room. She smiles.
"Hello, my sweeties. Did you have fun?" she asks.
"Yes, mom. We played nice," Lily says.
"Me too," Ben says.
Mom looks at the table. She sees the envelope. It is empty. She frowns.
"Where is my letter?" she asks.
Lily and Ben look at each other. They are scared. They do not know what to say.
Lily pokes Ben. She whispers in his ear.
"Tell her, tell her!" she says.
Ben pokes Lily back. He whispers in her ear.
"No, you tell her, you tell her!" he says.
Mom hears them. She bends down. She looks under the couch. She sees the letter. It is torn. She sighs.
"Who did this?" she asks.
Lily and Ben look at the floor. They are sorry. They do not want to make mom sad.
They hug mom. They say together.
"We did, mom. We are sorry. We love you."
Mom hugs them back. She is not angry. She loves them too.
She says.
"It's okay, my sweeties. I forgive you. But next time, please be careful with my letters. They are important. They are from grandma. She misses us a lot."
Lily and Ben nod. They promise to be careful. They ask mom to read the letter to them. Mom smiles. She reads the letter. It is from grandma. She says she loves them a lot. She sends them kisses and hugs. Lily and Ben are happy. They send kisses and hugs back to grandma. They thank mom for the letter. They say they miss grandma too. They hope to see her soon.

Ben and Tom are friends. They like to play football in the park. One day, they find a big box near the trees. They open the box and see many things inside. There are books, toys, clothes, and a shiny football.
"Wow, look at this football!" Ben says. "It is new and red. Can we play with it?"
Tom nods. He likes the football too. He takes it out of the box and kicks it to Ben. Ben kicks it back to Tom. They have fun with the football.
But then, a man comes to the park. He looks angry. He sees the box and the football.
"Hey, you kids!" he shouts. "That is my box and my football! Give them back to me!"
Ben and Tom are scared. They do not know the man. They do not want to give back the football.
"But we found them here," Ben says. "They are not yours."
"They are mine!" the man says. "I left them here for a while. They are very useful to me. The football is a gift for my son. The books are for my work. The toys and clothes are for charity. Now, give them back or I will call the police!"
Ben and Tom do not want to make the man more angry. They do not want to go to the police. They decide to give back the football and the box. They are sad. They liked the football.
"Sorry, mister," Tom says. "We did not know. Here is your football and your box."
The man takes the football and the box. He does not say thank you. He walks away.
Ben and Tom look at each other. They are still friends. They do not need the football to play. They can play with other things. They go to the swings and have fun.

Lily likes to run in the park with her dog Spot. Spot is a big dog with black and white fur. He likes to chase balls and birds and Lily. One day, Lily and Spot run to the big tree. Lily sees a hole in the tree. She wants to look inside.
Lily puts her hand in the hole. She feels something hard and sharp. It hurts her hand. She pulls her hand out. She sees a nail in the hole. The nail is dry and rusty. Lily cries. Spot barks. He wants to help Lily.
Lily's mom hears Lily and Spot. She runs to the big tree. She sees Lily's hand. She sees the nail. She hugs Lily and says, "Don't worry, my sweet. I will make it better." She takes Lily and Spot to the car. She drives to the doctor. The doctor cleans Lily's hand and puts a band-aid on it. He gives Lily a sticker and a lollipop. He says, "You are very brave, Lily. The nail can't hurt you anymore."
Lily smiles. She says, "Thank you, doctor. Thank you, mom. Thank you, Spot." She hugs them all. She feels better. She still likes to run in the park with her dog Spot. But she doesn't put her hand in the hole anymore. She knows the nail is there. She knows it is dry and sharp. She knows it is not a toy.

Sara and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they find a big box under a tree. They think it is a treasure.
"Wow, look at this!" Sara says. "Maybe there are toys or candy inside!"
"Let's open it!" Ben says. He tries to lift the lid, but it is too heavy. He asks Sara to help him.
They push and pull, but the box does not move. They are sad. They want to see the treasure.
Then, a tall man comes to the tree. He has a hat and a coat. He sees the box and the children.
"Hey, what are you doing?" he says. He sounds angry. "This is my box! Go away!"
Sara and Ben are scared. They do not know the man. They do not want to make him mad.
"But we found it first!" Sara says. "We want to see the treasure!"
"There is no treasure!" the man says. "This is just a box of old books! They are mine! Now leave!"
He grabs the box and walks away. He does not look at the children. He does not say sorry.
Sara and Ben frown. They are not happy. They think the man is mean. They wish they could see the treasure.
They go to the swings and try to forget the box. They hope to find a real treasure someday.

Anna and Ben like to play with crayons. They have many colors and they make marks on paper. Sometimes they make marks on the wall too, but Mommy does not like that. She says it is not polite to make marks on the wall.
One day, Anna and Ben are playing with crayons in their room. Anna wants to make a mark on the wall. She thinks it will be fun. She takes a red crayon and strikes the wall hard. She makes a big mark. She smiles and says, "Look, Ben! I made a mark on the wall!"
Ben sees the mark and he is scared. He knows Mommy will be angry. He says, "No, Anna! That is bad! Mommy will be mad! You should not make marks on the wall!"
Anna does not listen to Ben. She thinks he is silly. She says, "It is not bad. It is pretty. I like to make marks on the wall. You can make one too. Here, take a blue crayon and strike the wall."
Ben does not want to make a mark on the wall. He wants to be polite. He says, "No, thank you. I do not want to make a mark on the wall. I want to make marks on paper. That is polite. Mommy likes that."
Anna gets angry. She says, "You are no fun. You are boring. I do not want to play with you. Go away!"
Ben feels sad. He does not want to fight with Anna. He loves his sister. He says, "I am sorry, Anna. I do not want to go away. I want to play with you. But please do not make marks on the wall. Mommy will be sad. And we will be in trouble."
Anna thinks for a moment. She looks at the mark on the wall. She looks at Ben. She looks at the crayons. She says, "You are right, Ben. I am sorry too. I do not want to make Mommy sad. I do not want to be in trouble. I want to be polite. Let us make marks on paper. That is fun too."
Ben smiles. He says, "OK, Anna. Let us make marks on paper. We can make many colors and shapes. We can make a picture for Mommy. She will be happy."
Anna and Ben hug. They take their crayons and paper. They make marks on paper. They make a picture for Mommy. They are polite. They are happy.

Lily liked to paint. She had many colors and brushes. She painted flowers and animals and houses. She made a big mess on the table and the floor. But she did not care. She was happy.
One day, she painted a picture for her grandma. She painted a big heart and wrote "I love you" with red paint. She was very proud of her picture. She wanted to send it to her grandma. She asked her mom for help.
"Mom, can you help me send this picture to grandma?" she said.
"Sure, Lily. That is a very nice picture. Grandma will love it. But first, we need to clean up your mess. Look at all the paint on the table and the floor. We need to be organized and tidy," her mom said.
"Okay, mom. I will help you. But can we send the picture today?" Lily said.
"Yes, we can. After we clean up, we will put the picture in an envelope and write grandma's address. Then we will go to the post office and mail it. Grandma will get it in a few days," her mom said.
Lily nodded. She was excited. She hoped grandma would like her picture. She helped her mom clean up the paint. She was organized and tidy. She put her colors and brushes in a box. She wiped the table and the floor with a cloth. She thanked her mom for helping her. Then they went to the post office and mailed the picture. Lily smiled. She loved her grandma. She could not wait to hear from her.

Lily and Tom were going to the park with Mom. They liked the park. They could play on the swings, slide down the slide, and run on the grass. They were very happy.
But on the way, they saw a cat. The cat was on the road. It looked scared and hurt. It had a cut on its leg. Lily and Tom felt sorry for the cat. They wanted to help it.
"Mom, can we stop and help the cat?" Lily asked.
"Of course, dear. We can delay going to the park for a little while. The cat needs our help. You are very compassionate, Lily and Tom," Mom said.
Mom parked the car and got out. She took a blanket and a bottle of water from the trunk. She gently wrapped the cat in the blanket and gave it some water. The cat purred and licked Mom's hand.
"Thank you, Mom. You are very kind," the cat seemed to say.
Lily and Tom smiled. They were glad the cat was feeling better. They petted the cat and talked to it softly.
"Can we take the cat home, Mom?" Tom asked.
"Well, we have to find out if the cat has a home already. Maybe it has a collar or a tag with its name and address. If not, we can take it to the vet and see if they can find its owner. If no one claims the cat, then maybe we can adopt it. How does that sound?" Mom asked.
Lily and Tom nodded. They liked that idea. They hoped the cat would be their new friend.
They got back in the car and drove to the vet. They did not mind delaying going to the park. They had found a better way to spend their day. They had shown compassion to a cat in need. And they had learned a valuable lesson. Sometimes, helping others is more fun than playing.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play outside when it is sunny. But today it is rainy and they have to stay inside. They are very bored.
They look at the window and see a big puddle. They want to jump in the puddle and splash. They ask their mom if they can go outside. Mom says no, it is too wet and cold. They have to wait until the rain stops.
Anna and Ben are sad and angry. They think mom is mean. They look for something fun to do inside. They find an umbrella in the closet. They open the umbrella and pretend it is a tent. They crawl under the umbrella and make funny noises.
Mom hears the noises and comes to see what they are doing. She sees the umbrella on the floor and the twins under it. She smiles and says they are very clever. She asks if they want to play a game with her. They say yes, they want to play.
Mom takes the umbrella and holds it over her head. She says she is a giant and they are tiny ants. She pretends to chase them around the room. They run and hide and laugh. They wave at mom and she waves back. They have fun and forget about the rain. They are not bored anymore.

Tom and Anna were bored. They wanted to play catch, but it was raining outside. They looked around the house for something to do.
"Let's play catch in the kitchen!" Tom said. He saw a big ball on the floor.
"OK!" Anna said. She liked to play catch. She followed Tom to the kitchen.
They threw the ball to each other. They were careful not to hit anything. They had fun.
But then, Tom threw the ball too hard. It flew past Anna and hit the refrigerator. The refrigerator door opened. A lot of food and drinks fell out. Some of them broke and spilled on the floor.
"Oh no!" Tom and Anna said. They were scared. They heard their mom coming.
"What is this mess?" their mom said. She was angry. She saw the ball, the food, and the drinks. She saw Tom and Anna.
"Tom and Anna, you are in big trouble!" she said. "You should not play catch in the kitchen. You should be quiet and careful. You wasted a lot of food and drinks. You have to clean this up and go to your rooms. No more playing for today!"
Tom and Anna felt bad. They said sorry to their mom. They helped her clean the kitchen. Then they went to their rooms. They were sad. They wished they had played catch outside.

Tommy was very happy. His birthday was soon. He wanted to invite his friends to his party. He asked his mom for help.
"Mom, can I invite Sam and Lily and Ben and Anna to my party?" he said.
"Of course, my dear. You can invite whoever you want. It's your special day," his mom said.
"Can I invite Aunt Lucy too?" he said.
His mom frowned. She did not like Aunt Lucy. Aunt Lucy was ignorant. She always said mean things to Tommy and his mom. She did not know how to be nice.
"Tommy, I don't think Aunt Lucy would enjoy your party. She doesn't like fun things. She likes to sit and complain. She might make you and your friends unhappy," his mom said.
"But she is my aunt. She is family. Maybe she will be happy if I invite her. Maybe she will be nice to me," Tommy said.
His mom sighed. She loved Tommy very much. She wanted him to be happy. She did not want to hurt his feelings.
"Okay, Tommy. If you really want to invite Aunt Lucy, you can. But don't be sad if she doesn't come or if she is rude. You have many other people who love you and who will celebrate with you," his mom said.
Tommy smiled. He hugged his mom. He was excited for his party. He hoped Aunt Lucy would come and be nice. He hoped she would learn how to have fun. He hoped she would not be ignorant anymore.

Lily and Tom were hungry. They wanted to eat dinner. Mommy was cooking in the kitchen. She had a big pot of water on the stove. She put some potatoes in the water. She said, "The potatoes will be soft and yummy soon. But don't touch the pot. It is very hot and dangerous. You can get hurt."
Lily and Tom nodded. They played with their toys in the living room. They waited for the potatoes to be ready. They smelled something good. They heard Mommy say, "Dinner is ready. Come and eat."
Lily and Tom ran to the kitchen. They saw Mommy put some potatoes on their plates. She also gave them some cheese and broccoli. They said, "Thank you, Mommy. This looks delicious."
They started to eat. They liked the potatoes. They were soft and yummy. They also liked the cheese and broccoli. They ate everything on their plates. They said, "We are full. We finished our dinner."
Mommy smiled. She said, "I'm proud of you. You ate all your vegetables. You can have some dessert now. How about some ice cream?"
Lily and Tom cheered. They said, "Yes, please. We love ice cream."
Mommy gave them some ice cream. They ate it with spoons. They licked their lips. They said, "This is the best dinner ever. Thank you, Mommy."
Mommy hugged them. She said, "You're welcome, my sweeties. I love you."

Sam and Ben are best friends. They like to play with cars and balls and blocks. They go to the same school and sit next to each other. They have a lot of fun.
But one day, Sam is sick. He has a fever and a cough. He has to stay at home and rest. He cannot go to school or play with Ben. He is sad and bored. He misses Ben a lot.
Ben is sad too. He does not have Sam to play with. He does not have anyone to share his snacks or jokes or stories. He misses Sam a lot.
The next day, Sam feels a little better. He wants to see Ben. He asks his mom if he can go to school. His mom says no, he has to stay at home for one more day. But she has a surprise for him. She gives him a big envelope. She says it is from Ben.
Sam opens the envelope. Inside, he finds a drawing of him and Ben playing with cars and balls and blocks. He also finds a small toy car with a zipper on it. He can unzip the car and put things inside. He thinks it is very cool and playful. He smiles.
He sees a note from Ben. It says: "Dear Sam, I miss you. I hope you feel better soon. I made this car for you. You can unzip it and put your snacks or jokes or stories inside. Then you can zip it and keep them safe. I can't wait to play with you again. Your friend, Ben."
